current.title: Active configuration
current.description: These parameters are used for all new calculations. Each persisted calculation freezes the version used.

create.title: New configuration version
create.description: Publish a new version of the general configuration. The previous version is automatically deactivated.
create.error: An error occurred while publishing the version

delete.title: Delete inactive version
delete.description: Confirm deletion of the inactive version
delete.confirm: This action is irreversible. Only inactive versions can be deleted.
delete.error: An error occurred while deleting the version

form.combatant_threshold_date_help: Date separating combatants who joined before from those who joined after. Typically 1959-01-01.
form.pre_threshold_percent_help: Fraction between 0 and 1 applied to combatants with income before the join date
form.post_threshold_percent_help: Fraction between 0 and 1 applied to combatants with income on or after the join date
form.internationalist_increment_help: Absolute amount added to the pension when the applicant fulfilled internationalist mission
form.minimum_pension_help: Minimum pension amount. If below, the minimum pension increment is applied
form.maximum_pension_help: Absolute cap of the pension. Must be greater than or equal to the minimum pension
form.minimum_pension_increment_help: Absolute amount added when the pension falls below the minimum
form.payment_day_help: Day of the month when payment is made (1-30)
form.month_to_provitional_help: Months from payment day until the collection window opens (> 0)
form.month_to_expired_help: Months of the open window until closure (> 0)
